name: Bhosle household
notes: Family-level placeholder linked to the corresponding clan candidate. This record is restricted to the documented Maloji-to-Shahaji line, not every person sharing the Bhosle/Bhosale surname. Rawlinson records Maloji's 1604 grants of Poona and Supé jagirs and Chakan and Shivneri forts, his death in 1619, and Shahaji's return to Ahmadnagar service. Vaidya dates a later Adil Shahi service interval to about October 1625 through about the end of 1627, after which Shahaji returned to Nizam Shahi service. Thus Nizam Shahi service is the supported 1622 position. The alleged Chitor/Rajput descent is expressly treated by Rawlinson as an unverified origin claim and is excluded. Grants and jagirs are not represented as outright clan ownership of each fort. No founder, genealogical links, current head or branch membership is filled without direct evidence.
